**Why the decision was made**  
The model looks at the information it has about you and estimates a very high chance (about 98 %) that the loan could be missed. Three things stood out most: you have two accounts that are 60‑89 days past their payment dates, and three accounts that are 30‑59 days past due. Those recent late payments add a lot of risk in the model’s view. In addition, the amount of credit you are using on revolving accounts is about 62 % of the total credit available to you, which also pushes the risk higher. Together, these factors lead the system to label the application as “high risk.”
